title: Light Japanese Basmati Rice Pilaf
description: A simple and savory Japanese-inspired pilaf made with basmati rice, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat
Add 1 small onion, diced, and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes
Add 2 cloves of garlic, minced, and cook for an additional minute
Add the basmati rice and stir to combine with the oil and onion mixture
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is lightly toasted
Add 250ml of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the rice is cooked
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot
